Package com.lemarketjames.reports.insight

Class VolumeInsightService

java.lang.Object
com.lemarketjames.reports.insight.VolumeInsightService
@Service public class VolumeInsightService extends Object
Compares the traded volume of the last completed period with the period before it. Both are whole periods, because a period still in progress would always look like a drop against a finished one. Nothing is cached: every call reads the view, so the figures move forward by themselves as each report-time-zone day ends. Share volume is the figure that is flagged (BR-17), as it is the one the staff tile shows.

    • compareRanges

      public VolumeComparisonResponse compareRanges(LocalDate currentFrom, LocalDate currentTo, LocalDate previousFrom, LocalDate previousTo)
      Compares two ranges the caller picked. Each range runs from its first to its last day, both included, in the reports time zone; ranges may overlap and need not be the same length.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - when a day is missing or a range is reversed (answered with 400)
